summary: Quote on an NSE equity from a 1501-json-full event in both shapes a payload may have: its quote nested in Touchline, then at the message root. The desktop reads either and sends every quote field.

notes: The payload is the JSON string XTS puts in the event.

No recorded 1501-json-full settles where its quote sits: the desktop's XTS fixtures are built, not captured (tests/fixtures/brokers/fivepaisaxts/stream.json quote_1501), the template web adapter reads 1501 at the root ('data is at root level', ibulls_adapter.py:775), and RMoney's reads Touchline when present ('Some payloads embed quote fields under Touchline, others send flat keys', rmoney_adapter.py:901, and its 1501 fallback looks in Touchline, :841-845). The case pins both shapes; a live capture of a 1501-json-full decides which the template's zeros come from.

deviations.reason: With the 1501 quote nested in Touchline this web adapter reads 1501 at the message root ('data is at root level') and sends average_price 0; the desktop reads Touchline when present, else the root. No capture shows which shape a real 1501-json-full has: a live capture decides between a web defect (the web loses the quote) and a shape that never occurs. The root-shape push in the same case matches.

Two shapes of 1501 here. With the quote nested in Touchline this web adapter reads ltt at the message root and sends 0; whether a real 1501-json-full nests it (then the web loses the trade time) or not needs a live capture. With the quote at the root the web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST, a wrong unit: feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), which the desktop sends.
